en_title: Saber Interactive CEO Says Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival is Performing 'Extremely Well on PC and Consoles' with More to Come
subtitle: 更低成本的未来
opus_summary: Saber Interactive表示，《Hellraiser：Revival》发售后在PC和主机平台表现极佳。Matthew Karch认为。

paragraphs.en: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival has been a smash hit, says Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch in a post on LinkedIn, and it’s the first of a “series” of releases from the studio that will improve how it makes games in the future.
paragraphs.cn: Saber Interactive首席执行官Matthew Karch在领英发文称，《Hellraiser：Revival》已经取得巨大成功，同时也是工作室「系列」作品中的第一部。这些作品将帮助Saber改进未来的游戏开发方式。

paragraphs.en: Hellraiser: Revival has proven to be a smashing success, in spite of — or, perhaps because of — its super-spicy content. The game doesn’t skirt around the sex, blood, and gore that defined the source material, causing some content creators to get permanently banned despite taking pains to censor their playthroughs.
paragraphs.cn: 《Hellraiser：Revival》已经证明自己取得了巨大成功，这或许与其尺度极大的内容无关，也可能正是因为这些内容。游戏没有回避原作中的性、血腥与肢解元素，导致一些内容创作者即使努力对游玩视频进行审查，仍被永久封禁。

paragraphs.en: In an October 19 LinkedIn post, Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch praised the Hellraiser development team, revealing the title has been performing “extremely well on PC and console” since its October 8 release.
paragraphs.cn: 10月19日，Saber Interactive首席执行官Matthew Karch在领英发文称赞《Hellraiser：Revival》的开发团队，并透露这款游戏自10月8日发售以来，在PC和主机平台上的表现「非常出色」。

paragraphs.en: He also speculated that AAA titles with massive budgets and lengthy development timelines won’t be sustainable in the industry for much longer (if, indeed, they are right now), instead positing that AA games based on established IPs with smaller budgets are likely a more realistic path forward.
paragraphs.cn: 他还推测，拥有巨额预算、开发周期漫长的AAA游戏或许无法在行业中持续太久——如果它们如今真的还能持续的话。相较之下，基于成熟IP、预算更低的AA游戏可能才是更现实的发展方向。

paragraphs.en: “The game is testament to the notion that an established IP and solid AA development with controlled costs can produce great results and high user scores,” he wrote. “I believe a greater focus on these middle-market IP-driven products, rather than AAA behemoths, is the future to maintaining growth and momentum in the game industry.
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「这款游戏证明，成熟IP加上扎实的AA级开发和受控成本，能够带来出色的成果与较高的玩家评分。我认为，游戏行业未来要维持增长势头，就应当更加关注这类由IP驱动的中端市场产品，而不是AAA巨作。」

paragraphs.en: “While I believe there will always be a place for the properly-developed and budgeted AAA experience, a AA game that provides a great immersive experience for a lower price is less risky and can provide much greater returns on average.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我相信，只要开发和预算规划得当，AAA游戏体验始终会有一席之地。但一款以更低价格提供出色沉浸式体验的AA游戏，风险更低，平均而言也能带来高得多的回报。」

paragraphs.en: Karch went on to say that Hellraiser: Revival is “the first in a series of releases by Saber that will continue to prove out our methodology,” teasing that there’s “more to come in just a few short weeks.”
paragraphs.cn: Karch接着表示，《Hellraiser：Revival》是「Saber一系列作品中的第一部，这些作品将继续验证我们的开发方法」，并暗示「仅仅几周后就会有更多内容」公布。

paragraphs.en: While IGN scored the game a six out of ten , Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival boasts a “very positive” player score on Steam , and has earned no small amount of praise from content creators who showed up in droves to broadcast the game on release.
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《Hellraiser：Revival》打出6分（满分10分），但这款游戏在Steam上获得了「特别好评」的玩家评价。发售时，大量内容创作者纷纷直播这款游戏，也给出了相当多的赞誉。

paragraphs.en: Of course, given its content, it’s no surprise that some streamers got the ban hammer — but, according to its developers, that’s exactly what they were aiming for when they made it.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，考虑到游戏内容，一些主播遭到封禁并不令人意外。不过据开发者透露，这正是他们制作游戏时希望达到的目标。

paragraphs.en: "It was an unofficial goal of the team to be banned, unrated, or restricted at least somewhere in the world as one barometer of whether we’d done our jobs right,” narrative director Antony De Fault told IGN in an exclusive interview .
paragraphs.cn: 叙事总监Antony De Fault在接受IGN独家采访时表示：「团队有一个非正式目标，那就是至少在世界某个地方遭到封禁、无法评级或受到限制，以此作为衡量我们是否做好工作的标准之一。」

paragraphs.en: Even Clive Barker himself was impressed , saying he was “fearful at one point that the game would be overly censored but I’m genuinely astonished by how far they’ve been able to push it.”
paragraphs.cn: 就连Clive Barker本人也感到惊讶。他说：「我一度担心这款游戏会遭到过度审查，但他们最终能够将尺度推进到如此程度，着实让我感到震撼。」
